craft.name: Voyager 1

mission.status: Operating in interstellar space (crossed the heliopause 2012)
mission.summary: Farthest human-made object; flybys of Jupiter (March 1979) and Saturn and Titan (November 1980).

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-31, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Voyager 2

mission.status: Operating in interstellar space (crossed the heliopause 2018)
mission.summary: The only spacecraft to visit all four giant planets: Jupiter 1979, Saturn 1981, Uranus 1986, Neptune 1989.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-32, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: New Horizons

mission.status: Extended mission in the Kuiper Belt
mission.summary: First flyby of Pluto and Charon (14 July 2015) and of the Kuiper-belt object Arrokoth (1 January 2019).

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-98, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Parker Solar Probe

mission.status: Operating; perihelia at about 9.86 solar radii
mission.summary: Flies through the Sun’s outer corona; the fastest human-made object (~190 km/s at perihelion).

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-96, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Juno

mission.summary: Solar-powered polar orbiter of Jupiter since 4 July 2016, mapping its gravity, magnetic field, aurorae and deep atmosphere; close flybys of Ganymede, Europa and Io.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-61, CENTER=500@599, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Europa Clipper

mission.status: Cruise to Jupiter (Mars flyby March 2025, Earth flyby December 2026; arrival April 2030)
mission.summary: Will make about 50 close flybys of Jupiter’s moon Europa to assess whether its ocean could support life.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-159, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Psyche

mission.status: Cruise to (16) Psyche (Mars gravity assist May 2026; arrival 2029)
mission.summary: First mission to a metal-rich asteroid, using solar-electric Hall-effect thrusters.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-255, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Lucy

mission.status: Cruise to the Jupiter Trojans (Donaldjohanson flyby April 2025)
mission.summary: Twelve-year tour of eight asteroids, most of them Jupiter Trojans.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-49, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Hera

mission.summary: Planetary-defence follow-up to DART: measures Dimorphos’ mass and the crater DART left.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-91, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: JUICE

mission.summary: JUpiter ICy moons Explorer: Europa, Callisto and Ganymede flybys, then orbit Ganymede.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-28, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: BepiColombo

mission.status: Arriving at Mercury (orbit insertion planned November 2026)
mission.summary: Two orbiters (ESA’s MPO and JAXA’s Mio) travelling together on the Mercury Transfer Module.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-121, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Solar Orbiter

mission.status: Operating; Venus flybys tilt its orbit to view the Sun’s poles
mission.summary: Close-up images of the Sun from as near as 0.28 au and the first views of its polar regions.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-144, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: James Webb Space Telescope

mission.status: Operating on a halo orbit around Sun–Earth L2
mission.summary: The largest infrared space telescope: a 6.5 m segmented gold-coated beryllium mirror behind a five-layer sunshield.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-170, CENTER=500@399, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Cassini

mission.status: Mission ended 15 September 2017 (deliberate plunge into Saturn)
mission.summary: Thirteen years in orbit around Saturn (2004–2017); released ESA’s Huygens probe, which landed on Titan in January 2005.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-82, CENTER=500@699, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: DART

mission.status: Mission ended 26 September 2022 23:14 UTC (impact on Dimorphos)
mission.summary: The first planetary-defence test: a 580 kg spacecraft struck Dimorphos at 6.1 km/s and shortened its orbit around Didymos by 33 minutes.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-135, CENTER=500@20065803, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, VEC_TABLE=2, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME
